A abdominoplastia (dermolipectomia abdom: Abdominoplasty (abdominal dermolipectomy) is a plastic surgery indicated to remove excess abdominal skin and fat, as well as restore and suture weakened or separated abdominal muscles (diastasis recti).
É o procedimento ideal para quem sofre c: It is the ideal procedure for those struggling with abdominal skin laxity, typically occurring after multiple pregnancies, aging, or significant weight loss.
Vale ressaltar que ela não é um tratamen: It is worth emphasizing that it is not a weight loss procedure, but a body contouring surgery designed to restore silhouette tone and harmony.
Dependendo do grau de flacidez e acúmulo: Depending on the degree of flaccidity and fat accumulation, the surgeon may recommend different approaches:
Clássica (ou Tradicional): Indicada para: Classic (or Traditional): Indicated for moderate to severe flaccidity above and below the navel. Involves a suprapubic arciform transverse incision and repositioning of the umbilicus.
Miniabdominoplastia: Focada em quem tem: Mini-tummy tuck: Designed for patients with mild flaccidity and skin excess restricted to the lower abdomen below the navel. The incision is smaller, similar to an extended cesarean scar.
Em Âncora: Comum em pacientes de cirurgi: Anchor (Fleur-de-lis): Common in bariatric patients or individuals who lost significant weight. The scar resembles an anchor (horizontal and vertical), removing excess skin in both directions.
Lipoabdominoplastia: É a associação da a: Lipoabdominoplasty: Association of traditional abdominoplasty with liposuction to eliminate localized fat from flanks and waistline, achieving superior body contour.
O sucesso do procedimento depende direta: The procedure's success directly depends on postoperative care adherence:
Período de repouso: É necessário um repo: Rest period: Relative rest is required for approximately 15 to 21 days, walking with a slightly bent posture forward to avoid tension on sutures.
Cinta compressiva e drenos: O uso da cin: Compression garment and drains: Surgical compression garment is mandatory for 60 days to reduce swelling and shape the abdomen. Drains are typically kept for 3 to 5 days to drain accumulated fluid.
Exercícios e Sol: O retorno à academia o: Exercise and Sun exposure: Returning to gym workouts occurs gradually after 2 months, subject to medical clearance. Direct sun exposure must be avoided for up to 4 months to prevent scar hyperpigmentation.

O procedimento consiste na lipoaspiração: The procedure consists of liposuction of the pubic region and/or abdomen with harvesting of fat tissue, release of the suspensory ligament of the penis, and fat grafting (lipofilling) into the penile shaft. Its outcome is elongation and thickening of the penis, both in the flaccid state (greater gain) and in the erect state (smaller gain). This gain can range between 1.5 to 5 cm in length, along with a girth increase of around 30%.

Around 90% of operated men have normal-sized penises, with the primary goal of enhancing self-esteem and confidence!
A cirurgia não altera a potência sexual,: The surgery does not alter sexual potency, erectile function, sensitivity, or ejaculatory timing.
A idade mínima para se submeter à cirurg: The minimum age to undergo the surgery is 18 years. Patients with inguinal hernia must be treated before undergoing Phalloplasty.
Poderá haver a necessidade de um segundo: A second surgical stage may be required from 6 months after the primary surgery for a touch-up lipofilling session (girth thickening), given that the average fat reabsorption rate is around 30%; however, this varies from patient to patient.
O percentual de pacientes que necessitam: The percentage of patients requiring a second surgical stage (thickening touch-up) ranges between 10% and 15% of cases.
